Entso-E Cgmes Microgrid Test Configuration - Network Operations Description
An informational document describing an interconnected transmission network configuration with substations, lines, transformers, machines, and consumers.

BE Region
A geographical region labeled BE in which certain substations of the interconnected transmission network are located.

NL Region
